quote: Pilot plant study commenced at CIT-SENAI to build on the strong results from initial flotation beneficiation test work that produced a high-grade niobium concentrate and a rare earth enriched tailings stream… About 9 tonnes of near-surface saprolite material from the Araxá Project is being used in the study, which will continue for four to six weeks… Results from the beneficiation test work are expected in Q4 2026.
note: Opened St George ASX PDF 2 Sep 2026; CIT-SENAI pilot named; CapEx blank.
